collection.title: Porsche Panamera 2009 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Porsche Panamera 2009 to 2012 (970) requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 21" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
